scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Who the hell are you? Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 你到底是谁？给我滚出去！

scripts.text: I'm only talking to base level ^FF0000121-130^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我只和基础等级^FF0000121-130^000000的冒险者说话。

scripts.text: What? do not bother me. I am busy now.
scripts.translation: 什么？别来烦我，我正忙着。

scripts.text: You got a request from that little girl? The small, talktive and half-naked one over there?
scripts.translation: 你是从那个小女孩那里接到委托的？就是那边那个个子小、话多又穿得很少的女孩？

scripts.text: Say yes.
Avoid answering.
[Melody-Jack]
No. I do not care It will be fine if you stepped into this room not because you are lost. I need anyone except that kind of fool.
scripts.translation: 不，我不在乎。只要你不是迷路才走进这个房间就行。我需要帮手，但不要那种笨蛋。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Please listen to me, I will offer you an attractive suggestion.
scripts.translation: 听我说，我有个不错的提议。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I am ^ff0000Melody - Jack!^000000 The best man with best dagger skills.
scripts.translation: 我是^ff0000旋律·杰克！^000000最擅长使用短剑的男人。

scripts.text: Melody-Jack swipes a dagger in your direction.
scripts.translation: 梅洛迪·杰克朝你挥了挥短剑。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I am qualified to take secret missions. And right now you're in luck.
scripts.translation: 我有资格执行秘密任务，而你现在走运了。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
It seems that I have to lose one mission, deal and promise, I can not take it right now.
scripts.translation: 看来我不得不放弃一项任务、一笔交易和一个承诺，现在没法亲自处理。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Take my mission and solve the request of Aigu. I will compensate you.
scripts.translation: 接下我的任务，替我完成艾古的委托。我会给你报酬。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Our deal will be kept as a secret to Aigu. If you do not have 9 lives. Lets start.
scripts.translation: 这笔交易要对艾古保密。除非你有九条命，否则我们就开始吧。

scripts.text: Show me the requests!
Make small-talk.
[Melody-Jack]
What? Are you interested in me?
I am interested.
About requests
About a deal
What is a promise?
[Melody-Jack]
Well go away. I have no interest in you.
scripts.translation: 那就走开。我对你没兴趣。

scripts.text: I cannot stop it because of my bad credit. It drives me crazy.
scripts.translation: 我的信用不好，没法推掉这件事，真让我抓狂。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I am lucky to make a double contract with an adventurer like you. They are not included in our contract.
scripts.translation: 能和你这样的冒险者签双重契约真幸运。其他人不在我们的契约范围内。

scripts.text: To be honest I don't think there is anyone worthy of trust. Trust or promises are both silly.
scripts.translation: 说实话，我不觉得有谁值得信任。信任和承诺都很可笑。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I trust only me and my deal. Trust or promises are empty if they ar broken but if a deal is broken there is compensation or revenge.
scripts.translation: 我只相信自己和交易。信任或承诺被打破就毫无意义，但交易违约会有赔偿，或者报复。

scripts.text: Who're all of these kids?
[Melody-Jack]
I came out for nothing but I am supposed to fulfill my duty. I don't owe anyone a thing.
scripts.translation: 我白跑一趟，但还是得履行职责。我不欠任何人什么。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Oh, I made a mistake. You are not the level of adventurer I am looking for. I'm looking for base level 121 to 130 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 哦，我弄错了。你不是我要找的等级。我需要基础等级121到130的冒险者。

scripts.text: I do not like it but a deal is a deal. Please come back after clearing monsters in the places where Aigu asked to search.
scripts.translation: 虽然我不情愿，但交易就是交易。请清理艾古指定地点的魔物后再回来。

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower related
Rachel Shrine related
Nameless Island related
Abyss Lake related
[Melody-Jack]
Thanatos tower is the most annoying place. Do not worry about your compensation. I keep my word.
scripts.translation: 塔纳托斯之塔最让人头疼。别担心报酬，我说到做到。

scripts.text: Baroness of Retribution
Lady Solace
Mistress of Shelter
Dame of Sentinel
[Melody-Jack]
I think I finished today's performance. I cannot relax what if monsters show up suddenly.
scripts.translation: 我想今天的演出结束了。不过我不能放松，万一魔物突然出现呢。

scripts.text: I do not like that creature not because Aigu doesn't like them... How dare you? Who is punishing whom?
scripts.translation: 我讨厌那些生物，不是因为艾古讨厌它们...你敢说什么？到底是谁在惩罚谁？

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
These are some of the most dangerous creatures in the world. These creatures deserve no justice.
scripts.translation: 这些是世上最危险的生物之一，它们不值得得到宽恕。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Of course you can trust me. Because I believe in real deals. Lets sweep the creatures away.
scripts.translation: 当然可以相信我，因为我相信真正的交易。把那些生物清理掉吧。

scripts.text: Did you clear them? So that does not bother that little boy for a day. Good job.
scripts.translation: 清理完了吗？这样那个小男孩至少一天不会被打扰。干得好。

scripts.text: As you know, Thanatos Tower is where Aigu cares the most. It is the most dangerous place in some ways.
scripts.translation: 如你所知，艾古最在意塔纳托斯之塔。某些方面来说，那里也最危险。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Please clear monsters to help Aigu. Amateurs will make things messy.
scripts.translation: 帮艾古清理魔物吧。新手只会把事情弄得更糟。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
There must be a lot of them. Do not forget to keep this a secret.
scripts.translation: 那里一定有很多魔物。别忘了保密。

scripts.text: I think I finished today's performance. I can not relax... What if monsters show up suddenly?
scripts.translation: 我想今天的演出结束了。我还是不能放松...万一魔物突然出现呢？

scripts.text: The building does not seem to be designed by human beings and a strange melody is always playing there.
scripts.translation: 那栋建筑似乎不是人类建造的，而且里面总有奇怪的旋律。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Do not fall into the mood of the melody because that can be your last song you hear.
scripts.translation: 别被旋律迷住，那可能会成为你听到的最后一首歌。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Remember, there is strange music as sharp as knife to kill people in the world.
scripts.translation: 记住，世上有些奇怪的音乐像刀子一样能杀人。

scripts.text: Have you ever heard the melody they are playing? You will have a chance if that little boy begins to play the performance again.
scripts.translation: 你听过他们演奏的旋律吗？如果那个小男孩再次开始表演，你就有机会听到了。

scripts.text: Beautiful melody. Maybe it sounds beautiful because creatures are playing.
scripts.translation: 真美的旋律。也许因为演奏者是那些生物，才显得如此动听。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
However that is another obstacle. A deal is prior to personal interest anytime. So clear Lady Solace.
scripts.translation: 不过那是另一道障碍。任何时候交易都优先于个人兴趣。所以去清理慰藉女士。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
We are just keeping our end of the deal. Clear those creatures now.
scripts.translation: 我们只是在履行交易。现在去清理那些生物。

scripts.text: I think I finished today's performance. I can not relax... What if monsters show up suddenly?
scripts.translation: 我想今天的演出结束了。我还是不能放松...万一魔物突然出现呢？

scripts.text: Do you know an angel that turned into a monster? I do not know if it was an angel or not. But its appearance was an angel.
scripts.translation: 你知道有天使变成魔物吗？我不知道它是不是真天使，但外表确实像天使。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Do not panic due to beautiful appearances regardless if it is an angel or a creature. You should do your job.
scripts.translation: 不管对方是天使还是魔物，都别被美丽的外表迷惑。做好你的工作。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Everything has its time. Maybe you requested this because that time has come.
scripts.translation: 万事皆有时。也许你接到这个委托，正是时候到了。

scripts.text: Good. Let me know if someone is looking for me. If so, I might need to change the details of the deal.
scripts.translation: 很好。有人找我就告诉我。到时我可能要修改交易细节。

scripts.text: Do you know an angel that turned into a monster? I do not know if it was an angel or not. But its appearance was an angel.
scripts.translation: 你知道有天使变成魔物吗？我不知道它是不是真天使，但外表确实像天使。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I don't care if it is a real angel or just a creature. Clear Mistress of Shelter.
scripts.translation: 不管她是真天使还是魔物，去清理庇护女主人。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
Dying flowers fall down by rain and wind. That is what you have to do.
scripts.translation: 凋零的花朵会被风雨吹落。你要做的就是如此。

scripts.text: I finished my performance for today. I can not relax what if monsters show up suddenly.
scripts.translation: 我今天的演出结束了。我还是不能放松，万一魔物突然出现呢。

scripts.text: You may have felt they are watching once you stepped into the upper area of Thanatos Tower.
scripts.translation: 进入塔纳托斯之塔上层后，你或许已经感觉到有人在监视你。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Dame of Sentinel is not easy to handle so be sure to be ready to fight.
scripts.translation: 守护女骑士可不好对付，一定要做好战斗准备。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
It is a fine day to die. It will be you or them so do your best.
scripts.translation: 真是个适合赴死的好日子。不是你死就是它们亡，尽力而为吧。

scripts.text: You look fine. Maybe you are better than I thought? I did not check with my eyes though.
scripts.translation: 你看起来不错。也许你比我想象中更强？不过我也没亲眼确认。

scripts.text: You will meet them if Aigu requests. The Dame of Sentinels.
scripts.translation: 艾古委托你时，你自然会遇到她们——守护女骑士。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I wish they are cleared as well for her to request this adventure easily.
scripts.translation: 希望她们也能被清除，这样她就能安心发布委托了。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
A request for a request... Whatever.
Aigu's adventure leads to Rachel Shrine. Okay... It is not strange if ^FF0000that human^000000 Aigu looking for is found anywhere.
scripts.translation: 艾古的冒险之旅通向拉赫神殿。好吧...她寻找的^FF0000那个人^000000出现在任何地方都不奇怪。

scripts.text: Vanberk and Isilla
Hodremlin
Agav and Echio
[Melody-Jack]
You may take a rest for a day. You cleared enough but fanatic is increased.
scripts.translation: 休息一天吧。你清理得够多了，不过狂信徒数量增加了。

scripts.text: Someone who believes they are right are the most dangerous. This world is full of fools.
scripts.translation: 自以为正确的人最危险。这个世界上到处都是傻瓜。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Finally force others to believe what they believe. Lets clear Vanberk and Isilla.
scripts.translation: 他们还强迫别人相信自己的信念。去清理凡贝尔克和依西拉吧。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
It is not my business. But this time is different. A little boy might be in a danger so lets hurry to clear these monsters.
scripts.translation: 这本来与我无关，但这次不一样。小男孩可能有危险，我们赶快清理这些魔物吧。

scripts.text: Just a day. Will be fine.
Sanctuary in Rachel is prohibited to normal people from entering. You gotta know that.
scripts.translation: 拉赫神殿禁止普通人进入，你应该知道这一点。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
They think they can find a clue there but it is not a safe place. You should clear Vanberk and Isilla in advance.
scripts.translation: 他们以为能在那里找到线索，但那里并不安全。你应该先清理凡贝尔克和依西拉。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
Clear all as quickly as you can.
Unknown mosters are dangerous so clear them first. I will inform you if something happens.
scripts.translation: 未知魔物很危险，先清除它们。发生什么事我会通知你。

scripts.text: Cold teeth might be approaching. Its teeth are faster than your hands.
scripts.translation: 寒冷的獠牙可能正在逼近。它的獠牙比你的动作更快。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Rachel sanctuary will be approaching from everywhere. You should be careful of this one.
scripts.translation: 拉赫神殿里到处都可能有它们靠近，你要小心。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Just think of the job at hand. That will be enough.
scripts.translation: 专心做好眼前的任务就够了。

scripts.text: I am not that worried but are you safe? Not bitten?
scripts.translation: 我倒不是很担心，不过你没事吧？没被咬吧？

scripts.text: Fanatics are a problem. A more serious problem is that they show up suddenly.
scripts.translation: 狂信徒确实麻烦，更严重的是他们会突然出现。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Get rid of ^FF0000Hodremlin^000000 without any hesitation. Because they are very dangerous.
scripts.translation: 毫不犹豫地消灭^FF0000霍德雷姆林^000000。它们非常危险。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
They need faster hands than a head. I do not worry but you should be careful.
scripts.translation: 对付它们更需要手快，而不是多想。我不担心，你可要小心。

scripts.text: If you can talk. There are no requests right now. Take a rest for the day.
scripts.translation: 你还说得出话啊。现在没有委托，今天休息吧。

scripts.text: Full of madness here. I just feel disgusting.
scripts.translation: 这里到处都是疯狂的气息，真让人恶心。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
It is my feeling but you might like it. I am sure ^FF0000Agav^000000 and ^FF0000Echio^000000 will not like you.
scripts.translation: 这是我的感觉，不过你可能会喜欢这里。我敢肯定^FF0000艾嘉芙^000000和^FF0000艾奇奥^000000不会喜欢你。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
They will run into you. Do not hesitate and keep focused on the job.
scripts.translation: 它们会主动找上你。别犹豫，专心完成任务。

scripts.text: Found anyone? I wouldn't worry. A promise ia a promise and a deal is a deal.
scripts.translation: 找到人了吗？我倒不担心。承诺就是承诺，交易就是交易。

scripts.text: It is true that it is getting more dangerous inside of Rachel sanctuary, but Aigu will not care for things we are not sure.
scripts.translation: 拉赫神殿内部确实越来越危险，但艾古不会在意那些尚未确认的事。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
That was not that bad. But someone needs to help? Lets clear ^FF0000Agav^000000 and ^FF0000Echio^000000 inside of Rachel Shrine.
scripts.translation: 还不算太糟。不过总得有人帮忙吧？去清理拉赫神殿里的^FF0000艾嘉芙^000000和^FF0000艾奇奥^000000。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
I cannot leave so farewell.
scripts.translation: 我不能离开这里，就此告别。

scripts.text: Nameless Island is not known to usual adventurers. Aigu is also interested in there.
scripts.translation: 无名岛不为普通冒险者所熟知，艾古也对那里很感兴趣。

scripts.text: Ragged Zombie Hunting
Zombie Slaughter Hunting
Banshee Hunting
[Melody-Jack]
Ragged Zombie is reduced. It is a good time to proceed Aigu's request for a minute.
scripts.translation: 破败僵尸的数量减少了。正好可以继续处理艾古的委托。

scripts.text: It is easy to meet everything on Nameless Island. So boring.
scripts.translation: 在无名岛上什么都很容易遇到，真无聊。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Get rid of it and help Aigu and the other adventurers.
scripts.translation: 把它们清掉，帮助艾古和其他冒险者。

scripts.text: Did you take a bath? It smells in here. But I am sure that you had a hard time with the smell.
scripts.translation: 你洗澡了吗？这里好臭。不过我想你一路上也受够这股味道了。

scripts.text: The dead come back at night. Comes back sounds strange. Lets cut the crap.
scripts.translation: 死者会在夜里回来。说“回来”听起来怪怪的。别废话了。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Wish to clear ^FF0000Ragged Zombie^000000. It is easy because they show up everywhere.
scripts.translation: 去清理^FF0000破败僵尸^000000吧。它们到处都是，很容易找到。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
Take a ^FF0000bath^000000 and you won't smell anymore.
scripts.translation: 洗个^FF0000澡^000000，身上就不会再有臭味了。

scripts.text: I know the request to Nameless Island is not easy but I will be happy if you join again.
scripts.translation: 我知道无名岛的委托不容易，但如果你愿意再去帮忙，我会很高兴。

scripts.text: It was not easy for me either to step into Nameless Island. I am not that patient.
scripts.translation: 我也不轻易踏上无名岛。我可没那么有耐心。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
But adventurers should challenge once. ^FF0000Zombie Slaughter^000000 is worth clearing.
scripts.translation: 不过冒险者就该挑战一次。^FF0000殭尸屠杀者^000000值得清理。

scripts.text: You are quite good! You cleared them. It will take time to return.
scripts.translation: 你真厉害！把它们清理掉了。它们要花些时间才会回来。

scripts.text: They are dangerous unlike Ragged Zombie because they swing something sharp.
scripts.translation: 它们和破败僵尸不同，会挥舞锋利的武器，非常危险。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Please clear ^FF0000Zombie Slaughter^000000. Be careful to avoid their blades.
scripts.translation: 请清理^FF0000殭尸屠杀者^000000。小心避开它们的刀刃。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
You've got many things to take care of so I will hold my words. Clear them.
scripts.translation: 你还有很多事要处理，我就不多说了。把它们清理掉。

scripts.text: Banshee is cleared. Request is solved anyway but it is not the end. It will be required again sooner or later.
scripts.translation: 女妖已经清理了。委托算是完成了，但事情还没结束，迟早还会需要你帮忙。

scripts.text: You will see there are unwelcoming things while adventuring sometimes regardless of monsters and companions.
scripts.translation: 冒险途中有时会遇到不受欢迎的事物，不管是魔物还是同伴。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
This request is like that for me. I just do not like creatures or the reason of giving this request.
scripts.translation: 这项委托对我来说也是如此。我就是不喜欢这些生物，也不喜欢发布委托的理由。

scripts.text: You must be tired. You went to that tough place beyond your capability. Do not be angry. I will reward you for that.
scripts.translation: 你一定累坏了。你去了超出能力范围的危险地方。别生气，我会给你报酬。

scripts.text: Please clear ^FF0000Banshee^000000 inside of Nameless Island. Do not say no. You know it is for Aigu as well.
scripts.translation: 请清理无名岛上的^FF0000女妖^000000。别拒绝，你知道这也是为了艾古。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Both Banshee and Aigu are annoying. I would not do this request but you will be different. Right?
scripts.translation: 女妖和艾古都很烦人。换作我肯定不会接这委托，不过你不一样，对吧？

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
See? Someone needs this request. Clear ^FF0000Banshees^000000 at Nameless Island.
scripts.translation: 看吧，还是有人需要这项委托。去无名岛清理^FF0000女妖^000000。

scripts.text: Abyss Lake has requests from a little girl. Very dilligent.
scripts.translation: 小女孩的委托都和深渊湖有关。真勤奋。

scripts.text: Ferus and Bewler are cleared.
scripts.translation: 红贝勒斯与贝勒已清理

scripts.text: Gold and Blue Acidus are cleared.
scripts.translation: 金色与蓝色灰俄希托斯已清理

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Green dragons and Red dragons remind me of watermelons.
scripts.translation: 绿龙和红龙让我想起西瓜。

scripts.text: Abyss Lake... Do you possibly know how to get in there? You are not an adventurer with that information?
scripts.translation: 深渊湖...你知道怎么进去吗？你不会是连这点情报都没有的冒险者吧？

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Just in case I will give you a clue that a key and an entrance are going to be found around there.
scripts.translation: 以防万一给你个提示：钥匙和入口都在附近找得到。

scripts.text: Did you clear all of the dragons? Take a rest for a day.
scripts.translation: 龙都清理完了吗？休息一天吧。

scripts.text: Abyss Lake is full of dragons in and out. Dragons are not that special but there are so many.
scripts.translation: 深渊湖里里外外都是龙。龙倒不算稀奇，就是数量太多。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Which one is more dangerous between Ferus and Bewler? I do not know. Clear both of them.
scripts.translation: 红焰龙和蓝焰龙哪个更危险？我不知道。两个都清理掉吧。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
Neither green nor red are disturbing. But regardless, come back after clearing all.
scripts.translation: 不管绿龙还是红龙都不算难对付。总之全清理完再回来。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Take a rest. We should go and subdue Acidus dragons again.
scripts.translation: 休息一下吧。之后我们还得再去讨伐酸性龙。

scripts.text: Abyss Lake is not close. But it is worth visiting.
scripts.translation: 深渊湖离这里不近，不过值得一去。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
This is technically a training exercise but just pretend you are helping someone. There will be a reward.
scripts.translation: 严格来说这是训练，但你就当是在帮助别人吧。会有报酬的。

scripts.text: You are more of a talented adventurer than I thought. If you found a tactic, take care of it next time. This study is up to you.
scripts.translation: 你比我想象中更有本事。下次如果发现什么战术，就好好利用。这项研究就交给你了。

scripts.text: There is a cave where dragons are living inside of Abyss Lake. There are so many but flying things are annoying.
scripts.translation: 深渊湖里有个龙族栖息的洞穴。龙很多，但会飞的家伙真烦人。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Subdue them as best as you can. Do not mind their colors because they are all to be cleared.
scripts.translation: 尽可能制服它们。别管颜色，全部清理掉。

scripts.text: Take the request.
Stop.
[Melody-Jack]
Subdue the Gold and Blue Acidus monsters at the last level of Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation: 去深渊湖最底层讨伐金色和蓝色的酸性龙。

scripts.text: You finished helping Aigu or did you quit? Anyways I have no more business for you.
scripts.translation: 你是帮完艾古了，还是半途退出了？总之，我没别的事要委托你了。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
I am not sure if you found what you are looking for... I cannot be involved anymore. Thanks.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是否找到了要找的人...我不能再插手了。谢谢。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
{0} is cleared. No need to have more requests.
scripts.translation: {0}已完成，不需要再接其他委托了。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
{0} is cleared. A deal is a deal. I need to get paid.
scripts.translation: {0}已完成。交易就是交易，我得拿到报酬。

scripts.text: [Melody-Jack]
Hey there! ... Wait.?
[Aigu]
Oh, why aren't you a part of Eden Group?
scripts.translation: 哦，你怎么不是伊甸园的成员？

scripts.text: I'm only talking to base level ^FF0000121-130^000000 adventurers.
scripts.translation: 我只和基础等级^FF0000121-130^000000的冒险者说话。

scripts.text: Hi? A fine day like today. Can I ask for a favor? I heard that adventurers in Eden Group are nice.
scripts.translation: 你好！今天天气真好。可以请你帮个忙吗？听说伊甸园的冒险者都很热心。

scripts.text: I'm not the nice kind.
Sure, I'll help.
[Aigu]
yek.. I hate.
[Aigu]
Really? I will introduce myself! I am the head of the ^ff0000Dandelion band Aigu.^000000
scripts.translation: 真的吗？那我自我介绍一下！我是^ff0000蒲公英乐团团长艾古。^000000

scripts.text: [Aigu]
I just came back from a local performance. There is someone I wanted to meet but is missing now so I came to Eden Group for a request.
scripts.translation: 我刚结束当地的演出回来。本来想见一个人，但他现在不见了，所以我来伊甸园发布委托。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
I just decided to make a request by myself because no one is in charge and everyone is busy. Thanks for the help.
scripts.translation: 大家都很忙，也没人负责，所以我就自己发布委托了。谢谢你愿意帮忙。

scripts.text: It is nice to come back to Midgard! Very exciting as the first day.
scripts.translation: 回到米德加尔特真好！感觉就像第一天一样令人兴奋。

scripts.text: What is your request?
Talk about something else.
[Aigu]
Dandelion band travels all around the world and conveys healing music to people
scripts.translation: 蒲公英乐团周游世界，为人们带去疗愈的音乐。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
Actually our songs have no magic but I am sure it helps people because I am singing.
scripts.translation: 其实我们的歌没有魔力，但我相信我的歌声能帮助大家。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
I think it is difficult for you to get my request? For now, I think it will make more people lost. How about widening your sight by travelling?
scripts.translation: 我的委托对你来说可能有些难吧？现在看来，这反而会让更多人迷路。何不先旅行一番，开阔眼界？

scripts.text: [Aigu]
I made a shelter for someone I am looking for and lost adventurers. I want to know which adventurer has been there.
scripts.translation: 我为正在寻找的人和迷路的冒险者准备了避难所。我想知道是哪位冒险者去过那里。

scripts.text: Thanatos Tower search
Rachel Sanctuary search
Nameless Island search
Abyss Lake search
[Aigu]
I will ask to search again after for a while because there is hope since a trace of someone was found.
scripts.translation: 发现了某人的踪迹，所以还有希望。过一阵子我会再请你去搜索。

scripts.text: You know someone went there but you do not know who that is? Thank you. But let me ask you to search again tomorrow since we do not know who it is.
scripts.translation: 你知道有人去过那里，却不知道是谁吗？谢谢你。既然还不清楚那个人是谁，明天再帮我搜寻一次吧。

scripts.text: You may find shelter on top of the tower. Even that shelter only has water and a bonfire.
scripts.translation: 塔顶可能有避难所，不过里面只有水和篝火。

scripts.text: Adventurers are easily lost because of dangerous monsters and the height of thanatos tower. But it isn't impossible for some adventurers so please check for me.
scripts.translation: 塔纳托斯之塔里魔物危险，塔身又高，冒险者很容易迷路。不过也有人能到达那里，请帮我确认一下。

scripts.text: Begin to search.
Cancel.
[Aigu]
Thanatos tower is north of the Schwarzwald Republic! It is not far from Juno or Hugel.
scripts.translation: 塔纳托斯之塔就在谢尔茨共和国北部，离朱诺和胡格尔都不远！

scripts.text: Searching Rachel was enough. I will ask you again after a while.
scripts.translation: 拉赫的搜寻已经足够了。过阵子我再拜托你。

scripts.text: How was your trip? No special news. But it is not done yet so I will ask you to search again.
scripts.translation: 旅途如何？没有特别的消息吗？事情还没结束，所以我还要请你再搜索一次。

scripts.text: Not able to enter the sanctuary in a usual way. It is not easy but we can find a clue at Rachel.
scripts.translation: 没法用常规方式进入神殿。虽然不容易，但我们能在拉赫找到线索。

scripts.text: There is a sanctuary inside of Rachel Shrine. It is possible to get stuck there once you're inside.
scripts.translation: 拉赫神殿内部有一座圣域，一旦进去就可能被困在那里。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
Please take a look if there are any traces of lost adventurers at the southeast part of the 2nd floor in the middle zone.
scripts.translation: 请到第二层中央区域的东南部看看有没有迷路冒险者留下的踪迹。

scripts.text: Begin the search.
Stop.
[Aigu]
I wish you safety in your search.
scripts.translation: 祝你搜索顺利，平安归来。

scripts.text: Searching Nameless Island will continue at another time. How about taking a rest for a while?
scripts.translation: 无名岛的搜寻改天再继续吧。先休息一会儿怎么样？

scripts.text: Thank you! There are wandering adventurers also helping! We should continue to search anyway. Please help me next time again.
scripts.translation: 谢谢！还有四处游历的冒险者也在帮忙！我们还是得继续搜索，下次也请再帮我。

scripts.text: Maybe... hanging out and drinking with the dead. But please talk with me.
scripts.translation: 也许...是在和死人聚会喝酒吧。不过请跟我说说话。

scripts.text: Yes, Maybe they're not able to come because they've been captured by the dead! Nameless Island will be fine! Please search Nameless Island.
scripts.translation: 是啊，也许他们被死人抓住了，所以才没法回来！无名岛应该没事！请帮我搜索无名岛。

scripts.text: Begin the search.
Stop.
[Aigu]
I wil ask you to search the 1st underground of the monastery on Nameless Island. I cannot make you take that risk unless you volunteer.
scripts.translation: 我想请你搜索无名岛修道院的地下1层。除非你自愿，否则我不能让你冒这个险。

scripts.text: I will try to search Abyss Lake again after a while.
scripts.translation: 过一阵子我会再请你搜索深渊湖。

scripts.text: You came back safely but I guess there was no good result for your face. I will search more so do not disappoint! Thank you.
scripts.translation: 你平安回来了，不过看你的表情，似乎没什么好消息。我会继续搜寻，别让我失望哦！谢谢。

scripts.text: Maybe, disappointed and fallen down because a monster was not found on the ground of the lake.
scripts.translation: 也许是因为在湖底没找到魔物，才失望地倒下了吧。

scripts.text: I suggest to search Abyss Lake precisely the cave at the middle of the lake.
scripts.translation: 我建议你仔细搜索深渊湖，尤其是湖中央的洞穴。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
Yes! The end of a good adventure needs a dragon! I've heard there is a monster on the ground of a lake.
scripts.translation: 没错！精彩的冒险结尾当然要有龙！我听说湖底有只魔物。

scripts.text: Begin the search.
Stop.
[Aigu]
Abyss Lake is the fastest way to get to Hugel. Please visit 3rd floor of underground cave.!
scripts.translation: 深渊湖是前往胡格尔最快的路线。请到地下洞穴3层看看！

scripts.text: [Aigu]
I can't give you any more search tasks right now! You need harder challenges suitable for your level.
scripts.translation: 我现在没法再给你搜寻任务了！你需要适合当前等级的更高难度挑战。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
Oh, you've been working on {0} Adventure task. Let me clear your record, so you can work on better tasks.
scripts.translation: 哦，你正在进行{0}冒险任务。我来清除你的记录，这样你就能接更好的任务了。

scripts.text: [Aigu]
Oh, you've already finished {0} Adventure. Thank you for helping me out with this task!.
scripts.translation: 哦，你已经完成了{0}冒险。谢谢你帮我完成这项任务！

scripts.text: I found traces of someone who was here but I cannot find a clue. Lets go back and report to Aigu.
scripts.translation: 我发现了有人来过的痕迹，却没找到线索。回去向艾古报告吧。

scripts.text: There are traces of someone being here.
[Disguised Adventurer]
I am just working at this dangerous place for 5000 zeny... Are you the adventurer who got a request from Eden Group?
scripts.translation: 我只是为了5000zeny才在这个危险的地方工作...你是接了伊甸园委托的冒险者吗？

scripts.text: Yes
No
[Disguised Adventurer]
I could see that is not you at first glance!
The adventurers proceeding the request for Aigu are warped to the upper level on behalf of Aigu.
scripts.translation: 受艾古委托的冒险者会由我代为传送到上层。

scripts.text: Go up.
Do not go up.
[Disguised Adventurer]
It seems that you're currently not doing the Thanatos Tower adventure request. I'm sorry but I'm doing this for Aigu and not you.
scripts.translation: 看来你目前没有接取塔纳托斯之塔的冒险委托。抱歉，我是为艾古办事，不是为你。

scripts.text: Be careful! You can not come down once you go up. For Aigu!
scripts.translation: 小心！上去之后就不能下来。为了艾古！

scripts.text: Or please pretend not to know me! I will be in a danger if you blow my cover!
scripts.translation: 还有，请装作不认识我！要是你暴露了我的身份，我就危险了！
